commit a810d232fed90bf991d328b201af8f7d9bdb70c0
Author:     Ben Campbell <benc@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 1 07:42:50 2025 +0000
Commit:     Ben Campbell <benc@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 1 07:42:50 2025 +0000

    Bug 1718998 - Document behaviour of nsIMsgDatabase.getMsgHdrForKey()/.firstNew, and nsIMsgFolder.firstNewMessage. r=jtracey
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D254896

diff --git a/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl b/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
index 0c5b4dea244..cece87b26c1 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
+++ b/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
@@ -370,8 +370,9 @@ interface nsIMsgFolder : nsISupports {
   readonly attribute boolean hasFolderOrSubfolderNewMessages;
 
   /**
-   * return the first new message in the folder
-   *
+   * Return the first new message in the folder.
+   * If there are no new messages, accessing this will throw an
+   * error.
    */
   readonly attribute nsIMsgDBHdr firstNewMessage;
 
diff --git a/mailnews/db/msgdb/public/nsIMsgDatabase.idl b/mailnews/db/msgdb/public/nsIMsgDatabase.idl
index 3c40af36081..08a718b5817 100644
--- a/mailnews/db/msgdb/public/nsIMsgDatabase.idl
+++ b/mailnews/db/msgdb/public/nsIMsgDatabase.idl
@@ -306,8 +306,11 @@ interface nsIMsgDatabase : nsIDBChangeAnnouncer {
    */
   attribute PRTime lastUseTime;
 
-  // get a message header for the given key. Caller must release()!
-
+  /**
+   * Returns a nsIMsgDBHdr for the corresponding key.
+   * If the requested message is not in the database, this will throw
+   * NS_ERROR_ILLEGAL_VALUE.
+   */
   nsIMsgDBHdr getMsgHdrForKey(in nsMsgKey key);
   nsIMsgDBHdr getMsgHdrForMessageID(in string messageID);
 
@@ -551,6 +554,10 @@ interface nsIMsgDatabase : nsIDBChangeAnnouncer {
   void setUint32PropertyByHdr(in nsIMsgDBHdr aMsgHdr,
                               in string aProperty, in unsigned long aValue);
 
+  /**
+   * Returns the key of the first new message.
+   * If there are no new messages this will be nsMsgKey_None.
+   */
   readonly attribute nsMsgKey firstNew;
 
   attribute nsIMsgRetentionSettings msgRetentionSettings;
title: Bug 1718998 - Document behaviour of nsIMsgDatabase.getMsgHdrForKey()/.firstNew, and nsIMsgFolder.firstNewMessage. r=jtracey
